title: Define a complete public Tarium domain ontology
summary: Maintain a project-owned, self-contained ontology documenting domain entities, attributes, identifiers, relationships, semantics, sources and versioning, with mutually consistent human-readable and machine-readable descriptions.

rationale: Tarium's public constitution defines a specialized, independently selectable project requirement. Overlap with general Nomos guidance is intentionally preserved and auditable.

conditions: The task concerns an independently authorized public Tarium candidate or member project.
